question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 GAAP opex guide is $9.2B (non-GAAP $9.0B). The past three GAAP guides were 7.7 -> 8.5 -> 9.2, steps of +0.7 to +0.8B, and actuals came in slightly under guide. Management's 'low 50s' FY27 opex growth on FY26 GAAP of $23.08B (non-GAAP recast is slightly lower) implies a Q4 opex of about 9.4-10.5B depending on basis; both methods overlap near 10.0B. Upside tail: GAAP-only acquisition costs or a hiring/compute ramp; downside: Q3 coming in under guide resets the base. No Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found.
calls.dossier:
- Quantity: GAAP operating-expense guidance for Q4 FY27 stated in NVIDIA's Q3 FY27 earnings release (Outlook section), in $B. Resolves off the press-release outlook figure, not the actual reported opex.
- Event window: the Q3 FY27 release, expected around Nov 18-19, 2026 (scheduled resolution 2026-11-17T21:00Z). No resolution-criteria text was given, so the window is taken from the question title. As of 2026-10-11 the release has not happened.
- Guidance history, GAAP (non-GAAP): Q1 FY27 guide 7.7 (7.5), set Feb 2026 [NVIDIA Q4 FY26 PR]; Q2 FY27 guide 8.5 (8.3), May 2026 [Q1 FY27 CFO commentary, SEC]; Q3 FY27 guide 9.2 (9.0), Aug 26, 2026 [Q2 FY27 PR].
- Actuals, GAAP (non-GAAP): Q4 FY26 6.794; Q1 FY27 7.621 (7.449); Q2 FY27 8.408 (8.232), up 10% q/q and 55% y/y [Q2 FY27 PR/CFO commentary]. Actuals came in slightly below the guide in both Q1 and Q2.
- Since Q1 FY27, non-GAAP includes stock-based compensation. The GAAP vs non-GAAP gap is now only acquisition-related and other costs: 0.176B in Q2 FY27 and 0.052B in Q2 FY26 [Q2 FY27 CFO commentary].
- FY26 total GAAP opex: $23.076B [NVIDIA Q4 FY26 release]. A full-year recast non-GAAP total was not found; quarterly gaps suggest it is about 0.1-0.3B lower.
- CFO on the Aug 2026 call: 'For full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s driven by a broadening of our product portfolio' and more use of AI tools; Vera Rubin ramp [Q2 FY27 transcript, Motley Fool]. The basis (GAAP vs non-GAAP) was not stated.
- Implied arithmetic: Q1+Q2 actuals plus the Q3 guide = 25.23 GAAP / 24.68 non-GAAP. FY total at +50-53% on a GAAP base gives an implied Q4 GAAP of about 9.4-10.1B. On a non-GAAP base (about 22.85B), implied Q4 non-GAAP is about 9.6-10.3B, or about 9.8-10.5B GAAP.
- Sequential steps in the GAAP guide: +0.8 (7.7 -> 8.5), +0.7 (8.5 -> 9.2).
- Status quo: guidance continues with a step-up of similar size.
- Tails: a large acquisition adds GAAP-only costs (upside); Q3 comes in under guide, lowering the base (downside).
- Market check: no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market found.
- Not found: whether any opex guidance revision happened between Aug and Oct 2026; any analyst consensus for Q4 FY27 opex.
